outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM).
finding: Pregnancies complicated by GDM were associated with increased maternal complications (higher cesarean section rates, preeclampsia) and fetal outcomes (higher prevalence of macrosomia, neonatal hypoglycemia, NICU admissions), particularly in preterm births.
mod_finding: Preterm deliveries had higher rates of cesarean sections (53%) compared to term deliveries.
birth_weight: 22% were macrosomic; 78% had normal birth weights.
gest_age: N/A (preterm births occurred in 15% of cases)
